description: Look up one paint colour by brand and exact name or code, e.g. brand "Sherwin-Williams" + "SW 7029" or "Agreeable Gray"; brand "Farrow & Ball" + "Hague Blue" or "30". Case, spacing and accents are ignored. A brand sold in several markets (Dulux UK/PL, Sikkens NL/DE/IT, Beckers SE/PL) may return one match per market. If nothing matches exactly, returns close suggestions instead.

name_or_code.description: Exact colour name or manufacturer code
